note: Fort fittings: the operator seat that stands at the seated console stations of the fort rooms (FortRoomKit.SEAT). Built-in ImageGen reskin of templates/fort-fittings-guide.png (code-rendered by fort-fittings-guide.py); exact prompt retained beside this file; raw retained unmodified. 1536x1024 RGBA, six 512px frames of the same seat as alternatives; frame 0 is exported at 128px, the rest are retained and excluded. Image generation did not hold scale on a mostly empty canvas (two single-frame attempts came back 1.5-2x too large), hence the six frames.
